crossRefs.note: It came to pass, when they had taken them out, that he said, “Escape for your life! Don’t look behind you, and don’t…
He spoke to the congregation, saying, “Depart, please, from the tents of these wicked men, and touch nothing of theirs…
All Israel that were around them fled at their cry; for they said, “Lest the earth swallow us up!”
Leave Babylon! Flee from the Chaldeans! With a voice of singing announce this, tell it even to the end of the earth…
Depart! Depart! Go out from there! Touch no unclean thing! Go out from among her! Cleanse yourselves, you who carry…
“Flee out of the middle of Babylon! Go out of the land of the Chaldeans, and be as the male goats before the flocks.
“Flee out of the middle of Babylon! Everyone save his own life! Don’t be cut off in her iniquity; for it is the time of…
“My people, go away from the middle of her, and each of you save yourselves from Yahweh’s fierce anger.
With many other words he testified, and exhorted them, saying, “Save yourselves from this crooked generation!”
I heard another voice from heaven, saying, “Come out of her, my people, that you have no participation in her sins, and…
Shake yourself from the dust! Arise, sit up, Jerusalem! Release yourself from the bonds of your neck, captive daughter…
Be in pain, and labor to give birth, daughter of Zion, like a woman in travail; for now you will go out of the city…

people.name: Babylon
people.line: Ancient Mesopotamian city, capital of Babylonian Empire, site of the Tower of Babel.

people.name: Jerusalem
people.line: The capital of Israel, a holy city for three religions

translations.web: ‘Come, Zion! Escape, you who dwell with the daughter of Babylon.’
translations.bsb: “Get up, O Zion! Escape, you who dwell with the Daughter of Babylon!”
translations.kjv: Deliver thyself, O Zion, that dwellest with the daughter of Babylon.
translations.asv: Ho Zion, escape, thou that dwellest with the daughter of Babylon.
